reviewer_role: Contributed runner logging/prior fixes; arithmetic audit only, separate reviewer required.

timing_saved_brackets.causal_limit: Saved data identify aggregate wall exhaustion and the interrupted aligned pose check; they do not isolate fsync, /proc CPU accounting, serialization, polling, or numerical computation as the sole cause.
timing_saved_brackets.static_durable_new: JSON serialization, flush and os.fsync occur before durable_new returns; raw helper line also flushes and fsyncs.
timing_saved_brackets.static_budget_check: Budget.check reads monotonic wall and cpu_total; SIGALRM checks every 0.02 seconds; no per-call accounting durations retained.
